correctness.rationale: From the six fiber rays, the only opposite ray pairs are the three antipodal A2-root pairs because each nonzero base pair sums to t_i!=0. These intrinsically recover the fiber lattice; quotient antipodal base pairs and their lift sums recover root multiset modulo D6. Pair flips form (Z/2)^k and stabilizing hexagon automorphisms together with permutations give the asserted semidirect product and order. Zero-sum differences equal a common delta, whose absolute value plus ordered minimum pairs yields unique normal form. Independent exact integer enumeration of ordered q triples for k=2..20 gave first counts A=(1,1,2,1,4,2,5,4) for k=2..9 and E=(1,1,2,0,4,0,4,2); matches the two generating functions. Asymptotics follow from pole orders (1/144)*(k^3/6)=k^3/864. The toric Fano/stability and KE symmetry criterion are imported from Wuebben, not independently reproved.
